text:
The price is quite high considering the clinic's condition and the diagnostic equipment.
The person who actually examined me didn't match the name and didn't look like me at all; they were very unprofessional. The medication didn't work; it took several weeks. The diagnosis was wrong, and I only went to the hospital once to find out.

The treatment was inaccurate, the diagnosis was wrong, and the medication was prescribed incorrectly. I only found out the diagnosis was wrong when I went to the hospital. What a waste of money. The clinic was old, dirty, and completely unsanitary. They just did a quick check-up and I paid.

The doctors here don't really examine people. People only go to the doctor with symptoms. But when you go to a clinic, describe your symptoms, and the doctor says everything is normal. I sprained my ankle, and the doctor didn't even examine me; he just said I walked normally. Who goes to the doctor like that?
The doctor gave very good advice.
Do you offer wound dressing services in the early mornings, around 2 PM?
Back pain and neck pain cannot be cured.
